title: LEAP: AI-related global catastrophe by 2050
windowEndRule: The relevant five-year period must end before the resolution date.
baseline: People alive at the start of the relevant five-year period.
causation: AI is the direct or proximate cause of the deaths. Proximate causation uses a but-for test: without substantial AI involvement within one year before the event, it would not occur or would be extremely unlikely. Subsequent attributable consequences count; incidental assistance that does not materially enable the event does not.
conditioning: Unconditional on AI progress, capability arrival, or deployment.
resolutionEvidence: Use widely recognized population/fatality sources; disagreements affecting resolution are settled by relevant experts.
